The '''Tarok Detention Center''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. Under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], known dissidents were incarcerated in Tarok Detention Center.
